server_user.description: Unix user account under which the rdiff-backup server runs for security isolation.

server_group.description: Unix group for the rdiff-backup server process.

root_path.description: Absolute filesystem path where backup data (including metadata and revision history) are stored.

server_port.description: TCP port on which the rdiff-backup server listens for client connections.

server_bind_address.description: IP address the server binds to. Use 127.0.0.1 to restrict to localhost only.

enable_ssl.description: Enable TLS encryption for client-server communication (recommended over untrusted networks).

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the server’s TLS certificate (PEM format). Required if SSL enabled.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the server’s TLS private key (PEM format, unencrypted). Required if SSL enabled.

ssl_ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying client certificates (optional).

allowed_hosts.description: List of IP addresses (CIDR or dotted quad) permitted to connect. Empty list allows all.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

compression.description: Compression level for data stream (0=none, 1=fast/low, 3=good/balanced, 6=slower/high, 9=max). Use 0 for CPU-limited environments.

log_level.description: Verbosity of server logs. Accepts: debug, info, warning, error, critical.

log_file.description: Path to server log file. Leave empty or omit to log only to stderr (systemd journal).

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain backup revisions before automatic pruning. Set to 0 to disable (not recommended).

paranoia_mode.description: Enable extra integrity checks (e.g., full hashes on every metadata write). Slower but safer.

preserve_xattrs.description: Preserve extended attributes (e.g., SELinux, Capabilities) on files and directories.

preserve_acls.description: Preserve POSIX Access Control Lists (ACLs) if supported by the filesystem.

exclude_patterns.description: List of path patterns to exclude from backups. Supports wildcards (*), globstars (**), regex, and rdiff-backup-specific syntax.

include_patterns.description: List of paths explicitly included (used to override broad excludes). Mostly relevant with wildcard excludes.

windows_compatibility.description: Enable Windows path and filename compatibility (e.g., case-insensitive matching, escape illegal chars).

allow_client_restore.description: Allow clients to initiate restores (revert files to older versions). Requires client trust.

user_mapping.description: Map remote usernames to local system accounts during backup/restore. Useful when backing up from heterogeneous systems (e.g., Windows AD).

items.description: Mapping from remote user to local user

group_mapping.description: Map remote group names to local system groups.

items.description: Mapping from remote group to local group

unix_socket.description: Path to Unix domain socket for local management (e.g., '/run/rdiff-backup.sock'). Optional.

require_auth.description: Require clients to authenticate using username/password (recommended for non-local backups).

auth_realm.description: Authentication realm string displayed to clients during auth negotiation.

trusted_groups.description: List of local Unix groups whose members are allowed to authenticate (only if auth required).

log_client_ips.description: Log client IP addresses in the server log. May be needed for forensics but consider privacy regulations.
